headline: Russian bomb strikes kill 24 at humanitarian aid centre in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia Oblast
dek: Russian forces launched several aerial bomb attacks on Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia Oblast, on the morning of Nov 2, initially striking a school where humanitarian aid was regularly distributed, then dropping nine more aerial bombs on a shelter where people were taking refuge. At least 24 people…
sources: Ukraine's State Emergency Service (DSNS) + President Volodymyr Zelensky, reported by Kyiv Independent
fault_line: Aid site as target: 24 dead at a school handing out humanitarian aid -- deliberate strike on civilians, or the latest civilian toll of a bombing campaign both sides frame differently?
